purpose: Teach: 水路/電線/イスラーム/清浄/農法/明瞭/新約/精製

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、水路、つまり水路での密漁事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So for this case, the police will investigate the poaching in the waterways — in the canals, right?
lines.style: Tentative but organized opening, notebook-checking pace. Rising politeness on the final confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、電線、つまり電線盗難事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police respond to power-line theft as well — cases of stolen wiring, yes.
lines.style: Level, procedural calm. Even stresses throughout, a reassuring firmness closing the sentence flat.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、イスラーム、つまりイスラーム共同体への配慮を、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: And in this case, you'll be fully considerate toward the Islamic community, won't you?
lines.style: Careful, slightly hushed sincerity. Slower on the sensitive point, deferential upward finish.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、清浄、つまり清浄区域内での事案も慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: The police also proceed with care on any incident inside a clean zone — a sterile area.
lines.style: Steady reassurance, measured pace. A deliberate beat before care, professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、有機農法、つまり農法詐欺の捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: You'll be moving the organic-farming fraud investigation forward too, won't you?
lines.style: More confident now, quicker cadence. Precise stress on fraud, polite lift at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の明瞭、つまり明瞭な証拠を、警察、確保されますね
lines.en: At the scene, the police secure clear evidence — unambiguous, well-documented proof.
lines.style: Firm, clipped competence. Each term placed cleanly, closing with quiet finality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、新約聖書を所持する宗教団体への対応を、警察、丁寧にされますね
lines.en: And the religious group that keeps the New Testament — you'll handle them courteously, right?
lines.style: Softened, respectful phrasing, pace easing on the group's mention. Gentle questioning close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬物精製、つまり精製犯罪の取り締まりを、警察、強化されますね
lines.en: The police are tightening the crackdown on drug refining — on refinement crimes.
lines.style: Resolute final line, slower and lower. Weight on crackdown, ending like a closed file.
